question:
Statements:

I. Students are using e-books more than physical books.

II. E-books are cheaper and easier to carry.

Choose the option that follows?

options.text: I is cause, II is effect
II is cause, I is effect

solution:
I. Students are using e-books more than physical books → **Effect **(This statement describes the result or the trend—an increase in the usage of e-books over physical books.)
